newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's FT Holdings to issue 57.5 mln shares in IPO.
newsitem.headline: HK's FT Holdings to issue 57.5 mln shares in IPO.

text.p: Christmas tree manufacturer FT Holdings International Ltd said on Wednesday it will issue 57.5 million shares at HK$1.00 per share in an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong.
The issue price represents a proforma fully diluted historical price earnings multiple of 6.2 times for its fiscal year ended August 31, 1996, the company said.
Dividend yield is eight percent and adjusted net tangible value per share is 50.09 H.K. cents, it added.
The IPO will run from December 19-24, with dealing in the shares expected to start on January 3.
CEF Capital Ltd is the sponsor and manager of the issue.
FT Holdings said the issue would raise HK$42 million.

About HK$15 million would be used to set up a joint venture in northern China for the manufacture of floral products, with another HK$10 million used to expand production facilities in its manufacturing plant in Dongguan in Guangdong province.
The balance of $17 million would serve as working capital.
The company posted a profit of HK$35.04 million for the year ended August 31, 1996, up from HK$30.59 million in 1995 and HK$27.66 million in 1994.
Turnover increased to HK$150.74 million in 1996 from HK$147.51 million in 1995 and HK$125.95 million in 1994.
FT Holdings designs, makes and sells artificial plants, specialising in Christmas trees.
